Write your Centre number, candidate number and name on all the work you hand in.
Write in dark blue or black pen.
You may use a pencil for any diagrams or graphs.
Do not use staples, paper clips, highlighters, glue or correction fluid.
DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES.
If working is needed for any question it must be shown below that question.
If the degree of accuracy is not specified in the question, and if the answer is not exact, give the answer to
three significant figures. Give answers in degrees to one decimal place.
For π, use either your calculator value or 3.142.
At the end of the examination, fasten all your work securely together.
The number of marks is given in brackets [ ] at the end of each question or part question.
The total of the marks for this paper is 56.
This document consists of 11 printed pages and 1 blank page.
1 The table shows the distances by road, in kilometres, between some towns in New Zealand.
Write down the distance between Rotorua and Hamilton.
Give your answer correct to 3 decimal places.
The time in Lisbon is the same as the time in Funchal.
A plane left Lisbon at 0830 and arrived in Funchal at 1020.
It then left Funchal at 1255 and returned to Lisbon.
The return journey took 15 minutes more.
What time did the plane arrive in Lisbon?
The Ocean View Hotel has 300 rooms numbered from 100 to 399.
A room is chosen at random.
Find the probability that the room number ends in zero.
A television screen size, Scm, is 80cm correct to the nearest centimetre.
Complete the statement for S in the answer space.
Sheila can pay her hotel bill in Euros (€) or Pounds (£).
The bill was €425 or £365 when the exchange rate was £1 = €1.14 .
In which currency was the bill cheaper?
Without using a calculator, show that 3 ÷ 2 = 1 .
You must show each step of your working.
